## [DJI RS 5 features, specifications and price annouced](https://camerajabber.com/photography-news/dji-rs-5-features-specifications-and-price-annouced/)
*Camera Jabber* | 29/01/2026 | Score: 1.00
Tags: photography, camera

> DJI has unveiled the RS 5, its latest camera stabiliser and one of the most advanced lightweight gimbals ever released in the Ronin Series. Designed for solo videographers and mirrorless creators, the RS 5 introduces a significant upgrade in tracking, stability, and operating efficiency, while also improving runtime and compatibility within DJI’s broader production ecosystem. Check out the full DJI Ronin RS 5 review here at Camera Jabber The star feature of the RS 5 is the RS Enhanced Intelligent Tracking Module, an evolution of DJI’s earlier tracking system that now allows videographers to frame and follow subjects directly via the gimbal’s touchscreen. The system can track not just people but also vehicles, pets, or inanimate objects, locking onto subjects up to 10 metres away. If a subject leaves the frame, reacquisition is automatic.
